content.title: Pizza and pie deals for Pi Day 2026
content.text: Pi Day is an annual national celebration of the mathematical concept, which is the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter and equals 3.14... March 14 is also reportedly the birthday of theoretical physicist Albert Einstein. On Saturday, restaurants and businesses nationwide will be celebrating one of the "nerdiest" days of the year with deals on actual pie, pizza pie and other delights. Here are some of the deals you can take advantage of this Pi Day: Traditional Pie Gopuff Gopuff is discounting select pie products, including Edwards Frozen Hershey’s Chocolate Cream Pie Slices and Edwards Frozen Key Lime Pie Slices, which will be 25% off on the holiday. Little Pie Company Little Pie Company is giving away a free Pi cookie to every customer all day at their NYC bakery. They also have special Pi Day pies available for nationwide delivery via Goldbelly. Milk Bar All Milk Bar locations will offer a “Pi à la Mode” deal: a slice of Milk Bar’s famed Milk Bar Pie alongside a cup of their signature Cereal Milk Soft Serve for $10 ($4 discount). Plus, get 10% off all pies online. Polly’s Pies Polly’s Perks members can get a free slice of pie when dining in (no purchase required). Other customers can get a free slice of pie with any entrée purchase when dining in. Pizza Pie &Pizza To celebrate Pi Day, &pizza customers can purchase pizza pies for $3.14 when they buy another pie and use the code PIDAY. 7-Eleven 7-Eleven is offering members of its loyalty programs a large pizza for $3.14 in 7-Eleven, Speedway and Stripes stores on Saturday, March 14. Anthony's Coal Fired Pizza & Wings Get a large 10-inch coal-fired cheese pizza for $3.14 with the purchase of any beverage on Saturday, March 14, at Anthony's Coal Fired Pizza & Wings. Valid for dine-in only until 4 p.m. BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse Get a full-size classic Pizookie for $3.14 with the purchase of a large or shareable pizza on Saturday, March 14, at BJ’s Restaurant & Brewhouse. Valid for dine-in only. Blaze Pizza When you buy one 11-inch pizza, you can get a second 11-inch pizza of equal or lesser value for $3.14 at participating Blaze Pizza locations on March 14. The in-store-only offer is one per person and valid on any original dough pizza. 'Doordash The food delivery service is offering nationwide Pi Day deals from three popular pizza chains: Pizza Hut, Sbarro and Blaze Pizza. Pizza Hut: On Pi Day, customers can buy one medium or large Create Your Own pizza and get one free at participating locations while supplies last. Sbarro: Between March 14 — April 6, DashPass members can save $4 off eligible orders of $20 or more from participating Sbarro locations on DoorDash. Additionally, DashPass members can save $5 off eligible orders of $25 or more from participating locations. Blaze Pizza: Between March 14 — April 6, customers who buy one Simple Pie 11-inch cheese pizza will get one free from participating locations while supplies last. Fresh Brothers Customers can order a personal pizza (Pure Pepperoni Pizza Original Crust or the Cheese Pizza Original Crust) for $3.14 while ordering online and using the code PIDAY on March 14. Instacart On March 14, Instacart users can get a free Red Baron pizza with their order at select stores, while supplies last. Sheetz Sheetz is selling cheese or pepperoni pizza flatz for $3.14 between March 14 — 20. The single-use offer is valid in the chain’s app. Wiseguy Pizza Visit in-store or online to get New York-style cheese and pepperoni slices for $3.14 with the code PIDAY2026. Other Burger King Members of Burger King's Royal Perks program can enjoy a free Hershey’s Sundae Pie or Cinnamon Apple Pie with any purchase of $3.14 or more all day Saturday. Keebler Enter for a chance to win a free Keebler Pi(e) Day Prize Pack for trying to complete the digits of pi as part of an Instagram giveaway that runs through March 20.
